President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has said that Ukraine's "long-range sanctions" (long-range strikes) hit two oil refineries in Russia on the night of 27-28 June.

Source: Zelenskyy on X (Twitter)

Details: According to the president, the strikes targeted the Slavyansk oil refinery in Russia's Krasnodar Krai, around 300 km from the front line, and an oil refinery in Yaroslavl Oblast, approximately 700 km from the Ukrainian border.

Quote: "We continue our operations that weaken Russia's ability to wage this war.

Each of our long-range sanctions means fewer resources serving Russia's war machine, and another step towards peace."

Background: Earlier, reports emerged that a fire had broken out at the Slavyansk oil refinery in Slavyansk-on-Kuban following an overnight attack.
